record.question: Answer any 4 (four) of the following questions: (a) Define 'Duty'. Mention the conditions for treating training as duty. (b) Define 'Lien'. Under what circumstances a Government servant who has acquired lien on a post retains the lien on that post. (c) What is the maximum limit of leave that can be granted for a continuous period? How did the period of absence from duty not regularized shall be treated? (d) Under what conditions the pay of the senior Officer can be stepped up to a figure equal to the pay of his junior Officer. (e) How is the standard licence fee calculated under FR 45-A? (f) Can the date of birth of a Government servant once recorded in the Service Book be altered? If so, in what circumstances and what is the procedure thereof?
